caption:
A fixed camera faces a weathered white brick wall under a pale sky. Two stepped brick pillars rise along the wall, and a dark blue spray-paint blotch marks the center above dry grass. For much of the opening the wall stays still, then a small pale sphere moves across the upper sky toward the wall's top edge. The pillars, graffiti, and grass remain in the same positions.

A sudden white flash floods the middle of the view, washing out the wall and sky before subsiding into warm orange light, and the sky darkens to blue-grey as the wall takes on a tanned hue. A bright fireball blooms at the graffiti area, throwing sparks upward and toward the right. A jet of fire extends to the right while a small burning piece arcs toward the lower right.

A rapidly expanding white smoke plume rises upward and rightward, partly hiding the graffiti. A small flame burns at the wall's base. The pillars and grass remain visible amid the burning.
relations: Fixed camera framing wall and stepped pillars persists while a pale sphere crosses upper sky toward the top edge.
White flash washing the center then subsiding to warm orange darkens the sky and tans the wall hue.
Fireball blooming at the graffiti throws sparks upward-right while a burning piece arcs toward the lower right.
Expanding white smoke rises upward-right partly hiding the graffiti; pillars, grass, and a base flame stay visible.
